basic_profile.bio: A passionate gamer and tech enthusiast living in the Pacific Northwest. I work as a software developer and enjoy spending my free time exploring the vast landscapes of Red Dead Redemption 2. I'm a night owl, typically online during late evening hours. Single, with a love for hiking and attending local gaming conventions. Not a fan of pseudointellectual discussions, but I enjoy engaging in meaningful debates. I have a soft spot for elephants and appreciate good game design.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science, I have a deep understanding of game mechanics and software development. I've been gaming since childhood and have self-taught myself various programming languages to enhance my modding skills. My work as a developer keeps me updated on the latest tech trends.
